summary: Converts DataFrames to Python data: dict-of-lists, list-of-dicts, tuples, named tuples, dataclass instances and Pydantic models. EgressToPythonData is a mixin whose collection conversions delegate to EgressPydataFromPolars; DataFrameEgressFactory maps every supported dataframe type to that strategy.
key_classes: EgressFromPolars (alias EgressPydataFromPolars) — concrete strategy converting via Polars rows
DataFrameEgressFactory — BaseStrategyFactory mapping CONST_DATAFRAME_TYPE to the strategy
BaseEgressDataFrame — abstract base (exported lazily as BaseEgressStrategy)
key_functions: EgressPydataFromPolars._to_list_of_tuples/_to_list_of_dictionaries/_to_dictionary_of_lists — collection conversions delegated to by EgressToPythonData
extension_points: Add a strategy by subclassing BaseEgressDataFrame and mapping it in DataFrameEgressFactory._configure_strategy_mapping
lifecycle_notes: a68147b6 removed transit policing; b65a9dba, f3a14b98, 3db50230 closed pandas transit cutover.
documentation_hooks: Exporting relations to Python dicts, lists, dataclasses and Pydantic models
risks: All dataframe types route to a single Polars-based strategy, so non-Polars inputs are converted first.

Module and class names in __init__ and factory use legacy aliases (EgressPydataFromPolars vs EgressFromPolars; BaseEgressStrategy vs BaseEgressDataFrame); the factory file header still mentions legacy mountainash_dataframes path.
Legacy-looking code with commented-out blocks in egress_factory.py.
open_questions: Whether the egress classes are meant as a public entry point or are reached only through Relation.to_* methods is not documented.

evidence.detail: DataFrameEgressFactory maps all types to EgressPydataFromPolars
